assumption_interface: check(*assumption_literals) + push/pop; assumptions restricted to free interface vars (API-validated; bound names rejected)
backend: Z3 theorem prover (native library bundled in wheel)

encoding.exists: z3.Exists (skolemized SAT; complete for finite-domain satisfiability)
encoding.forall: z3.ForAll (regression formulas only; Z3 decides finite-domain instances or returns unknown)
encoding.int: z3.Int (unbounded mathematical integers; exact, no wraparound)

incremental: one z3.Solver per compiled root; push/pop retains learned clauses
known_limits: Z3 unknown is reported as UNKNOWN, never coerced
Int+LIA+quantifiers: complete on finite-domain-bounded instances in practice; incompleteness reported, not hidden
model_extraction: solver.model() evaluated against declared free symbols; independent re-check against reference oracle
quantifier_strategy: native Z3 quantifier reasoning over finite-domain-bounded formulas; scope-correct binder normalization (S01_SCOPED_BINDERS) precedes compilation; no silent binder dropping
repro_install: pip install z3-solver==5.1.0.0 numpy==2.3.4 (Windows x64, CPython 3.13)
resource_accounting: per-query wall/CPU time + Z3 statistics (num_conflicts etc.); cumulative ledger FINAL_CLOSURE_RESOURCE_LEDGER.json
